Product Hunt is an internet company that specializes in the fields of start-ups, tech, and product development. It enables community members can submit, browse, vote, and comment on daily submissions of products and collections of products. 

It was founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $22,000,000 to $22,000,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
